scope: Read-only code snapshots explaining legacy cached-label conventions; these scripts were NOT executed in this experiment. Exact historical producer version for the scene0011 archive is unavailable.
observations: NYU40 semantics are derived from annotated mesh labels; instance IDs are objectId+1.
Labels are transferred to camera point clouds after applying dataset poses by unrestricted nearest neighbor.
Filtering uses the old predicted instance size >=1000 points and applies the same point mask to geometry and GT arrays.
Current candidate inference never reads this reference-label cache.
24 predeclared reference camera clouds pass >80% measured depth consistency within5cm; this confirms correspondence/units, not label correctness.
